Theorem
[Boundary local boundedness] 1. ch8:8.25\group ch08-generalized-solutions Under the hypotheses of Theorem 8.17, let $u$ be a subsolution. For $y\in \mathbb R^n$, $R>0$, and $p>1$, set \[ M=\sup _{\partial \Omega \cap B_{2R}(y)}u^+, \qquad u_M^+(x)= egin{cases} \max \{ u(x),M\} ,& x\in \Omega ,\ M,& x otin \Omega . \end{cases} \] Then egin{equation} \sup _{B_R(y)}u_M^+ \leq C\left(R^{-n/p}\| u_M^+\| _{L^p(B_{2R}(y))}+k(R) ight), ag {8.69} \end{equation} where $C=C(n,\Lambda /\lambda , u R,q,p)$.
Proof

\sketch Extend the boundary truncation by the constant $M$ and use the positive power tests from Theorem 8.17 after subtracting their boundary value. Their support lies where the structural inequalities apply, so the same iteration gives (8.69).

□
